purpose: Single canonical GitHub Actions OIDC verification boundary for Foundation and Shine Defence runtime ingestion paths.

signing.rotationRule: On an unknown kid, refresh JWKS once immediately before rejecting the token.

claims.runIdentity: run_id + run_attempt are mandatory decimal strings and feed the replay-binding layer.

invariants: Consumer functions do not implement JWT signature verification or JWKS fetching independently.
JWKS discovery cannot escape the GitHub Actions issuer origin.
Unknown signing keys trigger one forced refresh so normal GitHub signing-key rotation does not require a deployment.
An unknown key after refresh fails closed.
Audience, workflow, repository/ref and event restrictions remain consumer policy and are never weakened by the shared verifier.
Tokens older than the bounded issued-at freshness window are rejected even if their expiry claim has not yet elapsed.
run_id and run_attempt are mandatory verified claims before any replay-binding decision is made.
The verifier returns bounded identity metadata only; it does not return the raw token.
